note: allleg gives the k>=3 case and bothleg the k=2 case, with eta<=sigma and K depending only on arity and sigma, and exponential decay of Fourier coefficients is the Vane part of Firm. Transversality and f = delta...delta g are stated at real momenta only, which for analytic f and g is equivalent to [M]'s identity on the strip.

theorem bothleg (σ : ℝ) (hs : 0 < σ) : ∃ η K, 0 < η ∧ η≤σ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
    ∀ A s (f : Run 2 → Space 1 → ℂ), 0 ≤ A → (∀ i, Firm σ A (f i)) → Contractible (t:=1) f →
      (∀ i, Rays (s+2) (f i ∘ axes)) →
      ∃ g : CurRun 2 → Space 1 → ℂ, (∀ i, Firm η (A*K) (g i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Rays s (g i ∘ axes)) ∧ ∀ (p : Corn (Keys 1)) b,
          fromCurl (plotted (axes p)) (fun i => g i (axes p)) b=f b (axes p) := by
